intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Tustin for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events. The magic runs from December 4 (Christmas Tree Lighting and Holiday Stroll in Old Town Tustin) to December 14 (Kids Winter Crafternoon at Tustin Library), with a free holiday train at The District at Tustin Legacy (December 5) and Breakfast with Santa (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Tustin

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Tustin (2 already live and 2 new)
  • Meet Santa: photos with Santa at the tree lighting, at The District at Tustin Legacy and at Breakfast with Santa
  • Trains: a free holiday train at The District at Tustin Legacy on December 5
  • Free: the District's Holiday Celebration and the Old Town Tustin tree lighting
  • Season: December 4 to December 14
